rules: Uptrend: the pole top is a higher high (above the previous swing high, zigzag 6%) and the flag low a higher low (above the previous swing low); 21-day average rising, 200-day average rising. Pole: >= 15% rise in <= 15 sessions from the swing low to the highest high. Pause (3-25 sessions): Flag = highs and lows drifting down, Pennant = highs falling and lows rising, Rectangle = flat box;  falling or flat highs, pullback <= half the pole and <= 12%, no close above the pole top, close above the 200-day average. Early = the pole started within 4% of the 200-day average (fresh uptrend); established = 50 > 200-day average, both rising. Trigger = the flag's top line; stop = flag low (incl. the breakout day); exit = first daily close below the 21-day EMA (pole target shown for reference).
backtest: Tested 22 Nov 2026 (2,421 NSE stocks, 30,360 breakouts 2016-26): flag-low stop + exit on a close below the 21-day EMA +2.2% a trade (profit factor 1.71) vs +1.4% (1.34) selling at the pole target; breakout-day-low stop worse (stopped 81%). Rectangles +7.3% (PF 3.2), pennants +2.3%, flags +2.0%; established uptrends +2.7% vs new +1.9%. Last 2 years -0.6% a trade and portfolio drawdowns of 55-70% - watch only.
